name: @earendil-works/pi-desktop
description: Jip-pi GUI: Electron + React frontend over the AgentBackend protocol

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n renderer,main,preload,app "vite --config vite.renderer.config.mjs" "vite build --watch --config vite.main.config.mjs" "vite build --watch --config vite.preload.config.mjs" "wait-on tcp:5173 .vite/build/main.js .vite/build/preload.js && electron ."
scripts.build:vite: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('.vite',{recursive:true,force:true})" && vite build --config vite.main.config.mjs && vite build --config vite.preload.config.mjs && vite build --config vite.renderer.config.mjs
scripts.prepare:backend: npm run build:binary --workspace=@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent && npm run stage:backend
scripts.package: npm run prepare:backend && npm run stage:sdk && npm run build:vite && npm run stage:app && electron-builder --dir
scripts.make: npm run prepare:backend && npm run stage:sdk && npm run build:vite && npm run stage:app && electron-builder --win nsis

author: Jip-pi Contributors
